name: Palace of Fine Arts, first floor

source.description: Interior reconstruction traced from the official PFA Master Floorplan, page 1: https://palaceoffinearts.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/04/PFA-Master-Floorplan.pdf (accessed 2026-10-25). North up. Approximate scale calibrated from the plan's printed 132 ft 10 21/32 in dimension on page 2, converted to the 1188 px trace. The main theater auditorium at the south end is outside this map. Interior walls, door positions and room footprints are hand-traced; heights (8 m shell / 3 m partitions) and wall thicknesses are illustrative, not surveyed. Ground floor only; mezzanine not modeled. Restricted areas are labeled, not verified public routes.
